decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website, which suggests a peripheral role, but it uses the firm's vehicle-building know-how from its mining machines and is cheap to keep in the range.

The inclined furniture lift had a dedicated page and fits a coherent lift product family that is typical of specialised German machinery makers with steady demand from removal firms, so it is likely a core line.
The inclined building material lift shares components and customers with the furniture lift, and the construction boom supports demand, so keeping it is sensible.

The truck-mounted furniture lift is a higher-value variant of the lift family with its own page, and it targets professional removal companies, so the firm would likely keep it despite a somewhat more niche market.
